author: GamingBolt
description:
I legitimately had very little expectations from or interest in Splatoon Raiders, with the last few entries in the franchise convincing me that it was no longer for me. What I ended up getting is definitely my favorite game in the franchise since the Wii U original over a decade ago, one of my favorite exclusives on the Switch 2, a system that is rapidly building an enviable library of quality exclusive content, and one of my favorite loot games ever, in a genre where, over several decades, I’ve experienced no end of fantastic games. 

For an unassuming spin off in one of Nintendo’s so called lesser franchises, that’s a pretty strong outing, all said and done.
title: After a Week of Splatoon Raiders, I Have to Admit I Was Wrong [Review]

author: GamingBolt
description:
With Master Collection Vol. 2 of Metal Gear inching ever closer to its August 2026 release, we’ve been quite stumped by how nobody’s talking about Metal Gear Solid 4 hitting the PS5, Xbox, PC, and both Switch consoles is a significant development. This title has been a PS3 exclusive for eighteen years, remaining unplayable on many new systems and locking many players away from a release that remains quite relevant to the franchise. 

Well, we’ve since sat down and thought about it, and the results offer an interesting look at potential contributors to the muted response to MGS4’s return to the spotlight, albeit a shared one. Join us as we look at what’s going on with this, and why it should be generating more noise than it is.
title: Metal Gear Solid 4 Is Finally Escaping the PS3 - So Why Isn't It a Bigger Deal?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' open beta has concluded. Between PlayStation Network outages and PC performance issues, it was quite the weekend. 

Nevertheless, overall impressions are quite positive leading into its launch on August 6th for PS5 and PC. So, what better time to delve into 15 more things you should know about the 4v4 fighter before launch?
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - 15 MORE Things You Need to Know Before You Pre-Order
